integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Photorealistic live-action, a single continuous medium shot in a rustic mud village kitchen, preserving the vertical composition of <Picture 1>: the anthropomorphic shrimp — orange-pink shrimp head with long antennae and a black eye on a muscular human body wearing a dirty white sleeveless vest — crouches left of the clay chulha fire, facing right toward the anthropomorphic bottle-gourd woman — green gourd head with a serene human face, red blouse and white-red bordered saree, gold necklace and bangles — who sits stirring a black iron pot of steaming curry with a wooden spoon. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the two characters. The shrimp speaks with earnest, possessive expression, natural mouth movement and slight head and antennae motion, leaning a touch toward her; the gravelly, animated male shrimp (S1) says: <d>[Bengali] শুন লাউ, তুই আমারই… অন্য কারো সাথে ম্যাচ করিস না। আর লাউ রান্না করতে থাকবে।</d> Throughout the shot, the gourd woman keeps stirring the pot in a steady rhythm, glances briefly at the shrimp with a calm, slightly amused smile, then returns her gaze to the pot and keeps cooking. Warm golden light from the left window mixes with the flickering fire glow from below as steam drifts up from the pot. Toward the end, the shrimp settles back slightly after finishing his line while she continues stirring, flames flickering and steam rising.

overall_soundscape: Wood fire crackles and pops under the clay stove while curry bubbles gently in the iron pot. The wooden spoon scrapes rhythmically against the pot's rim, steam hisses softly, and the shrimp's body shifts faintly on the packed-mud floor.
